paths.title: How it works
paths.body: Two simple paths — one for people looking for work, one for people hiring.

why.title: Why ABLE
why.body: Built so everyone can use it — and so disability is never a label, a filter or a price tag.

skills.title: Real skills first
skills.body: Profiles lead with what you can do: work, certificates, reviews. There’s no field or filter for disability.

howTo.title: How do I…?
howTo.body: Short guides for the things people ask most.

profile.a: Sign in, choose “I’m looking for work”, and follow the 5 steps. Everything saves as you go, so you can stop and come back.

mic.a: Tap the mic in any text field and speak in Thai or English. Tap stop, check the text, and keep or edit it. You can always type instead.

certs.a: In step 4, upload a PDF or photo of each certificate with the issuer and date. You choose whether each one is public.

find.a: Add a position, then open your feed. Use filters for skills, location and work mode, and star the people you like.

chat.a: Tap Message on a profile or card. In the conversation, use the phone or camera buttons to call.

delete.a: Go to Settings → Your data. Download a copy first if you like, then delete your account by typing your handle.

free.a: Yes. Creating a profile, matching and messaging are free for talent and employers.

disclose.q: Do I have to say I have a disability?
disclose.a: No. Nothing asks about disability. If you want, you can add a private “Work setup I need” note and share it only with an employer you choose.

phone.q: Who can see my phone number?
phone.a: You decide for each contact: everyone, only employers you’re chatting with, or no one. The default is only employers you chat with.

verified.a: Every account verifies its email. Organizations can submit a registration number, which our team checks before showing the organization badge.

ai.q: How does AI use my data?
ai.a: Only when you use a mic or AI button, or for matching. Voice recordings are deleted right after they’re turned into text. AI suggestions are always yours to accept or edit.

phone2.q: Can I use it on my phone?
phone2.a: Yes. ABLE works in any modern phone browser and with VoiceOver and TalkBack. You can add it to your home screen.

languages.a: English and Thai, including the mic. Messages can be translated between them.

delete.q: How do I delete my account?
delete.a: Settings → Your data → Delete my account. Your personal data is removed straight away.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: What we collect, why, and the choices you have. Written in plain language.

p: ABLE is a talent platform that connects people looking for work with employers. For this prototype, ABLE is the data controller. Contact: privacy@able.example.
Account: your email, name and, if you sign in with Google, your Google profile name and photo.
Profile: what you choose to add — photo, headline, bio, skills, education, certificates, portfolio, posts and contact channels.
Private fields: date of birth, gender and the “Work setup I need” note. These are never shown publicly and never used to filter or rank you.
Activity: messages, offers, follows, stars and profile views, so the product works.
We never collect national ID numbers.
To provide the service you asked for (contract): your profile, matching, messages and calls.
With your consent: AI processing of your voice and text, the private work-setup note, and email notifications. You can withdraw consent at any time in Settings.
For legitimate interests: security, preventing abuse and keeping basic, anonymous usage counts.

When you use a mic or an AI button, your audio or text goes to OpenAI (speech to text, matching embeddings) and Anthropic (writing help, match reasons, translation). They act as our processors and do not use it to train their models under their API terms.
Voice recordings sent for transcription are deleted right after they’re turned into text — we don’t store them.
Your public profile text is used to compute matches. Private fields are never sent.
Your public profile is visible to everyone unless you make it private. You choose the visibility of each contact channel: public, only employers you chat with, or hidden.
Registration numbers submitted by organizations are used only for verification.
Hosting (Vercel), database and files (Supabase), email (Resend) and calls (Daily.co). Data may be processed outside Thailand with appropriate safeguards.

As long as your account is open. When you delete your account, we delete your personal data straight away and keep only anonymous aggregate counts. Security logs without personal content are kept for up to 90 days.

You can access, correct, download or delete your data, withdraw consent, and object to processing. See “Your data rights”. You can also complain to Thailand’s Personal Data Protection Committee (PDPC).

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: The simple rules for using ABLE.

p: You must be at least 15 years old (or have a guardian’s permission) and give true information about yourself or your organization.
No discrimination, harassment, scams or requests for money to apply. Employers must not ask for, filter by, or pay less because of disability, gender, religion, ethnicity or age.
We may remove content or suspend accounts that break these rules.
Offers sent in chat are messages, not contracts. Pay and terms are agreed directly between talent and employer. ABLE never suggests a rate.
AI drafts and match reasons are suggestions. You are responsible for checking anything you publish.
You keep ownership of what you post. You give ABLE permission to show it as you choose in your settings, only to run the service.
ABLE is a hackathon prototype. It is provided as is, without guarantees of availability. Sample profiles are fictional and labelled “Sample”.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.lead: ABLE uses only the cookies it needs to work.

p: Sign-in session (keeps you signed in, secure and httpOnly), language, theme, your cookie choice, and judge-mode sandbox id. These can’t be turned off because the site can’t work without them.
None. ABLE doesn’t load analytics or advertising scripts. If that ever changes, they will stay off until you accept them.
You can change your choice at any time with the “Cookie settings” link in the footer.

dataRights.title: Your data rights
dataRights.lead: Under Thailand’s PDPA (B.E. 2562) and GDPR-style principles.

p: Everything you entered is visible and editable in your profile and Settings.
Settings → Your data → Download my data gives you a ZIP with a JSON file of your data and your uploaded files.
Settings → Your data → Delete my account removes your personal data immediately, including conversations you were part of.
Turn AI processing, the work-setup note or email notifications off in Settings at any time. Withdrawing doesn’t affect what was done before.
Make your profile private, hide contacts, or block people. For anything else, email privacy@able.example.
You can complain to the Personal Data Protection Committee (PDPC), Thailand.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.lead: ABLE is built to be usable by everyone, with the tools you already use.

p: Instead of special “modes”, the site itself is built to work with screen readers (VoiceOver, TalkBack, NVDA), keyboard, zoom up to 200%, large system text, reduced motion and dark mode.
Automated checks (axe) on every page, keyboard walkthroughs, and layouts from 320px phones to large desktops. We aim for WCAG 2.1 level AA.
Every mic has a typing alternative, voice notes can be shown as text, and messages can be translated between Thai and English.
Video calls use Daily.co’s interface, which we don’t control. Some sample images have short descriptions only.
If something doesn’t work for you, email accessibility@able.example (placeholder). We read every message.

built.title: Built vs planned
built.lead: What works in ABLE today, and what comes next. No pretending.
built: Sign in with Google or a 6-digit email code
Talent profile builder with autosave, photos, certificates and portfolio
“Speak to fill”: mic on every text field, and “Fill my profile by voice” with review
“Write with AI” for bios and organization descriptions
AI matching (embeddings + skills + work fit) with “Why this match”
Matched feed with star, follow, skip, filters and swipe
Messages with photos, files, voice notes, offers, translation, read receipts
Notifications, emails for messages and offers
Reviews after an accepted offer, likes and comments
Privacy controls, consent records, data export and account deletion
Judge mode with sample data, English and Thai, light and dark
planned: Identity verification (Tier 3, government ID) — Phase 2; ABLE collects no ID numbers today
Native mobile apps (the web app is installable now)
Job boards import and calendar scheduling for interviews
More languages beyond English and Thai
